plain: Looseness in following rules or standards

webster.text: Looseness; slackness; the opposite of tenseness or tension.

more.text: Want of exactness or precision; as laxity of expression.
Looseness; defect of exactness; as laxity of morals.
Looseness, as of the bowels; the opposite of costiveness.

example.quote: S.-the prospect of anarchy from the laxity of government every where; and to other considerations.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, May 29, 1787
